name: International Stable Currency
oneLiner: ISC is a purchasing-power token tracking a basket of physical gold, investment-grade bonds, T-bills, global equities, and cash; price appreciates over time.
collateral: Basket of real-world assets (gold, bonds, T-bills, equity, cash)
pegMechanism: RWA-indexed basket tracking purchasing power; price appreciates over time

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Reviewed local metadata suppression: ISC's "Cash reserves" slice describes generic off-chain cash, not the unrelated CASH token tracked elsewhere.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit No retained: the apparent Upstream signal is a text match on a generic cash reserve label, with no coinId, blacklistable reserve flag, variant parent, CEX custody, or direct stablecoin reserve reference.
blacklistabilityReview.upstreamSuppressionRationale: Suppresses a resolver text false-positive where the generic reserve phrase "Cash reserves" matches the tracked CASH symbol. ISC metadata does not identify CASH token exposure or another upstream freezable asset.
